posts.title: Someone tried to steal €2k from me on a P2P crypto trade. It didn't work.
posts.description: Yesterday I got scammed on a P2P crypto trade. Or at least someone tried to. Here’s what happened and how I managed to get Revolut to side with me. What happened I took a sell order on RoboSats for 3,110,649 sats (~0.031 BTC) in exchange for €2,100 EUR via Revolut. The buyer had listed the order, I took it, the trade went through normally, I confirmed the Revolut payment and released the Bitcoin.
